gitCommit.subject: feat(canvas): add TextV2 floating toolbar with formatting controls (#1406)
gitCommit.body:
feat(canvas): add TextV2 floating toolbar with formatting controls (#1406)

* feat(canvas): add TextV2 canvas object type for pure text without speech bubble

Introduces a new TextV2 object type focused on plain text editing with
proper scaling behavior. Unlike the existing speech bubble text, TextV2
has no bubble/tail coupling and synchronizes fontSize with transform scale
(fontSize * scaleX on transform end, then resets scale to 1).

- Add TextV2Object type, factory function, and type guards
- Add textV2 tool with 'T' hotkey (speech bubble moves to Shift+T)
- Add selection, copy/paste, rectangle selection support
- Add Konva rendering component with keepRatio=true transformer
- Add property panel (font, color, alignment, orientation, spacing)
- Add layers panel and panel/frame child rendering support
- Add i18n strings for en, ja, zh-TW, zh-CN
- Add unit tests and e2e test scaffolding

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(canvas): add inline text editing for TextV2 via double-click

Double-clicking a TextV2 object on the canvas now opens an HTML textarea
overlay directly on top of the Konva text node, allowing users to edit
text in-place instead of only through the side panel.

- Add FloatingTextV2Editor component with position/scale-aware overlay
- Add onDblClick/isEditing props to TextV2Node
- Hide Konva text and transformer while editing
- Textarea matches font/color/alignment/orientation of the text object
- Escape or blur exits editing mode
- Key events stop propagation to prevent canvas shortcuts while typing

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(canvas): remove padding UI control from TextV2 property panel

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(canvas): align TextV2 text top for horizontal mode and fix inline editor offset

- Change verticalAlign to 'top' for horizontal text so it flows
  top-to-bottom naturally (vertical text stays 'middle')
- Fix inline editor textarea shifting on enter by compensating for
  border width with negative margin and calc-based sizing
- Scale top margin offset proportionally with font size to stay
  aligned across different zoom levels

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(canvas): add side/corner anchor transform behavior and TextV2 spec docs

Side anchors resize the container without scaling text; corner anchors
enforce uniform scaling and bake the result into fontSize on release.
Adds detailed TextV2 specification to docs/product/canvas/ and updates
object-types.md with TextV2Object type.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(canvas): fix TextV2 side-anchor locking and restore corner-anchor ratio lock

Stop baking scale into width/height during side-anchor drags — let the
Transformer handle them naturally and only resolve dimensions on transform
end. Re-add onTransform handler solely for corner drags to enforce uniform
scaling. Read final node dimensions instead of obj dimensions in transform
end handler.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(canvas): prevent text distortion during side-anchor drag with counter-scaling

Apply inverse scale to the Text and Rect children on each onTransform tick
during side-anchor drags so the text renders at its original size while the
container resizes. Reset counter-scale on transform end. Corner drags
continue to enforce uniform scaling unchanged.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(canvas): use boundBoxFunc for corner-anchor uniform scaling with correct anchoring

Move corner-anchor aspect ratio enforcement from onTransform into
boundBoxFunc with per-corner position adjustment so the opposite corner
stays fixed for all four corners. Keep onTransform only for side-anchor
counter-scaling. Update TextV2 spec docs to match.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* docs(canvas): simplify TextV2 spec to focus on behavior over implementation

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(canvas): use rotation-aware math for corner-anchor position anchoring

Replace axis-aligned position correction with trigonometric computation
that works correctly when the object is rotated. Computes the anchored
corner's absolute position using rotation, then derives the new box
origin to keep that corner fixed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(canvas): apply rotation to FloatingTextV2Editor overlay

Add CSS rotate transform matching the TextV2 object's rotation so the
inline editing textarea aligns with the rotated text on canvas.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(canvas): simplify TextV2 controls and fix deletion

- Remove text textarea from property panel (use double-click inline editing instead)
- Remove text orientation control (vertical text needs more work)
- Remove line height and letter spacing sliders
- Simplify property panel to: font family, size, color, alignment, style
- Fix TextV2 deletion by adding isTextV2Object to delete type checks
- Map T shortcut to TextV2, Shift+T to speech bubble
- Auto-enter inline edit mode on TextV2 creation with placeholder text
- Add rotation support to FloatingTextV2Editor overlay
- Fix pre-existing unused import lint errors

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(canvas): fix TextV2 auto-edit on creation and scale defaults by zoom

- Defer textarea focus with requestAnimationFrame so mouseup on the
  canvas doesn't steal focus back and trigger onBlur → onFinishEditing
- Scale fontSize/width/height inversely by canvas.scale when creating
  TextV2 so text appears a consistent visual size regardless of zoom level

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(canvas): move TextV2 controls to floating toolbar above selected object

Replace the right sidebar panel for TextV2 with a floating toolbar that
appears above the selected text object, matching the FloatingQuickActions
pattern. The toolbar includes font family, font size, color swatch, text
alignment, and bold/italic/underline controls. Also fixes missing
addToSelection/removeFromSelection destructuring in gazai-canvas.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* refactor(canvas): merge TextV2 toolbar into FloatingQuickActions as single row

Combine text formatting controls and quick actions into one horizontal
toolbar. Font family, size, color are inline; alignment and font style
(B/I/U) are compact dropdown menus. Add onDragMove to TextV2Node so the
toolbar follows during drag. Remove standalone FloatingTextV2Toolbar.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(canvas): fix TextV2 copy-paste and improve clipboard reliability

- Always write to localStorage in setClipboardData as reliable fallback
- Check localStorage in handlePasteEvent when clipboardData is empty
- Call handlePaste directly on Ctrl+V keydown as fallback for synthetic events
- Add dedup guard in handlePaste to prevent double-paste
- Grant clipboard permissions in Playwright config for e2e tests
- Exit text editing mode before copy-paste in e2e test
- Reduce selectTool timeout and focus canvas before keyboard shortcut fallback

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(canvas): address PR review — guard TextV2 creation, clamp fontSize, clean up types

- Add clickedOnEmpty guard to prevent TextV2 creation when clicking existing objects
- Clamp fontSize input to 1-200 range in FloatingQuickActions and TextV2Info
- Make isBold/isItalic/isUnderline required (non-optional) on TextV2Object
- Remove unused textOrientation from TextV2Object type and factory
- Remove unnecessary ?? false / || false coalescing patterns
- Delete unused text-v2-info.tsx (replaced by floating toolbar)
- Update docs and unit tests to reflect type changes

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(canvas): move TextV2 tool before manga group in toolbar order

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

---------

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
